title: Latent-width scaling for learned semantic state addressing
question: Does increasing latent width improve the learned continuous semantic state retriever when training budget and negative coverage are fixed?
hypothesis: H_width: the current low-recall boundary is partly capacity-limited; increasing latent width from 8 to 16 to 32 should improve held-out target-state recall before saturation.

arms.name: latent_8
arms.intervention: dual linear encoder with latent dimension 8

arms.name: latent_16
arms.intervention: dual linear encoder with latent dimension 16

arms.name: latent_32
arms.intervention: dual linear encoder with latent dimension 32

endpoints.name: target_top1_recall
endpoints.role: primary — correct opaque persistent state selected

endpoints.name: target_rank_mean
endpoints.role: secondary — mean rank of correct target state

endpoints.name: training_updates
endpoints.role: secondary — fixed optimizer updates across arms

endpoints.name: negative_evaluations_total
endpoints.role: secondary — fixed negative coverage but width-dependent arithmetic

decision_rule.condition: latent_32 recall >= latent_8 recall + 0.15 and latent_32 recall >= 0.50
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that encoder capacity is a material limiting factor in the current semantic retriever
decision_rule.does_not_license: that 32 dimensions is optimal or that width generalizes to other workloads

decision_rule.condition: latent_32 recall is within 0.05 absolute of latent_8 recall
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that increasing latent width is largely saturated in this configuration
decision_rule.does_not_license: that different representation families would not help

decision_rule.condition: latent_32 recall improves over latent_8 by >0.05 and <0.15
decision_rule.licenses: partial evidence that representation capacity contributes to retrieval quality
evidence that wider latent representations reverse the observed gain in this workload
decision_rule.does_not_license: that larger width is generally harmful

held_constant: H=64 task anchor and A1 H-invariant query/state stream
one deterministic positive view per update
no evaluation address or gold target enters training
prior C5 and learned-state results remain frozen
